description: Total area of above ground swimming pool detected on this swimming pool, in square feet.

Confidence in above ground swimming pool classification on this swimming pool. When multiple detections contribute: top-level feature classes on the parcel (e.g. all roofs, all vegetation segments) are combined so confidence rises with corroborating detections; sub-attributes within a parent feature (e.g. staining on a roof) take the maximum across detections. Null when the corresponding area is 0.
Fraction of the parcel's total swimming pool area detected to be above-ground.
